definitions.explanation: A button that is pressed to activate a device, signal, or mechanism. Found on elevators, crosswalks, appliances, and various machines.

examples.japanese: {押|お}しボタン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}して→押す：02854_osu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{横断歩道|おうだんほどう}→横断歩道：06502_oudanhodou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{押|お}しボタン{式|しき}⟦{信号|しんごう}→信号：03258_shingou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}した→押す：02854_osu⟧。
examples.english: I pressed the push-button traffic signal at the crosswalk.

examples.japanese: ⟦エレベーター→エレベーター：01340_erebeetaa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{押|お}しボタン⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{反応|はんのう}しなくて→反応する：20204_hannousuru⟧⟦{困|こま}った→困る：00861_komaru⟧。
examples.english: I had trouble because the elevator button wasn't responding.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{押|お}す→押す：02854_osu⟧ (to push) + ⟦ボタン→ボタン：02963_botan⟧ (button, from Portuguese 'botão'). Refers specifically to buttons designed to be pressed, as opposed to toggle switches or other controls.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {押|お}しボタン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}す→押す：02854_osu⟧: to press a push button
- {押|お}しボタン{式|しき}: push-button type/style
- {押|お}しボタン{式|しき}⟦{信号|しんごう}→信号：03258_shingou⟧: push-button traffic signal (at a pedestrian crossing)
- ⟦{非常|ひじょう}→非常：01598_hijou⟧{押|お}しボタン: emergency push button

USAGE:
Commonly encountered at pedestrian crosswalks ({押|お}しボタン{式|しき}⟦{信号|しんごう}→信号：03258_shingou⟧), on elevators, and on industrial equipment. The word emphasizes the physical pressing action, distinguishing it from touch-sensitive or other types of controls.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦ボタン→ボタン：02963_botan⟧: button — general term for any button
- ⟦スイッチ→スイッチ：03848_suicchi⟧: switch — a toggle or flip-type control
- ⟦タッチパネル→タッチパネル：05226_tacchipaneru⟧: touch panel — a screen-based input method
